name: bandit.r010_m060_basecamp_observer_bridge_mcw
description: Narrow R010-M060 proof that the southwest observer fixture's registered player basecamp reaches the first loaded production observer consumer. It stops after the next structural cadence and does not dispatch, return, report, decide, or create a hostile operation.

steps.label: post_load_basecamp_observer_bridge_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the registered-basecamp fixture reaches normal gameplay

steps.label: preflight_idle_zero_lead_camp
steps.abort_reason: saved state was not the idle five-member, zero-lead causal boundary
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members, zero leads, and no active outing exist before the observer cadence

steps.label: wait_1_hour_through_next_structural_observer_consumer
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: the real wait menu is opened before choosing one hour
steps.expected_visible_fact: the next structural cadence reaches the loaded player observer

steps.label: audit_loaded_observer_reads_player_camp_identity
steps.abort_reason: the loaded observer did not read the registered player camp identity before observation
steps.expected_immediate_state: the production observer sees the direct player camp at exactly the loaded avatar OMT

steps.label: audit_loaded_observer_does_not_reject_player_camp_identity
steps.abort_reason: the production observer rejected the loaded player camp identity
steps.expected_immediate_state: no observation_rejected trace exists for the loaded avatar OMT

evidence_contract.claim: the loaded player observer reads a legitimate player basecamp at its own OMT
evidence_contract.preconditions_and_interventions: the derived fixture copies the hostile source camp and adds only a named your_followers basecamp record in the player and overmap registries at the loaded avatar OMT; no lead, dispatch, observation, report, decision, or operation is injected
evidence_contract.causal_boundary: fixture installation ends before the next structural observer cadence
evidence_contract.real_code_path: hourly structural cadence -> direct overmap basecamp lookup -> loaded player opportunity observation
evidence_contract.expected_transition: idle/no-lead -> registered basecamp accepted by the loaded observer
evidence_contract.negative_control: the run must not log an observation_rejected event for the loaded avatar OMT
evidence_contract.pass_fail_rule: green only when registry, near-basecamp, and observation-result traces all identify the loaded avatar OMT without an observation rejection
